content.text: Tests dominate; let me look at the definition and the non-test callers.

The server verifies the token in `verifyTurnstileToken()` in `src/auth/captcha.ts:24`. That function posts to Cloudflare's endpoint, `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify`, which is defined at `src/auth/captcha.ts:12`. I didn't open the file, so I haven't read the verification logic itself. That includes how it reads the secret key and how it handles the `TURNSTILE_NON_BLOCKING` flag. The secret key is listed as `CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` (`src/auth/captcha.ts:44`) in the generated `llms-full.txt`. `.env.example` uses `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` instead, so the two may not match.

These routes call it:
- `app/api/auth/login/route.ts:129`
- `app/api/auth/signup/route.ts:111`
- `app/api/auth/password/recover/route.ts:30`
- `src/server/api-v2.ts:372` and `src/server/api-v2.ts:501`, which pass `body.captchaToken`

Each caller also passes the client IP.
